text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down roughly 2–3% over the past day, with altcoins showing sharper losses, signaling modest risk-off sentiment across the board. The Fear & Greed index at 28 reflects a fearful mood that has barely budged over the week, suggesting anxiety rather than panic selling. Bitcoin dominance holding steady at 56.5% and 24-hour volume at $64B indicate traders are rotating into safer assets within crypto rather than exiting entirely.
